summary: This is a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by FibroBiologics, Inc. to register an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $6.15 million of its common stock through H.C. Wainwright as sales agent. The filing discloses the sales agreement, compensation of 3.0% of gross proceeds, and recent reverse stock split effective March 30, 2026. There is no minimum offering amount and proceeds are not escrowed. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation event.
